description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Hatharaliyadda D/S Division for Ambawa Storage Tank and an errata to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2064/04 of 26.03.2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a water supply project. It specifically describes the acquisition of immovable property (land) with detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including lot numbers, boundaries, location details, and the name/address of the claimant. While it mentions a government minister and uses ministerial powers, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property description, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
